GAP: lines 59-80 split volumes into two kinds. The comment says 'keep only entries that don't look like absolute/relative paths (i.e. are real named-volumes)': the regex /^\/|^\./ excludes host-path entries from the 'docker volume create' exec, and docker::run receives them unchanged as bind mounts. The set exercises only the named kind (runopts volumes p8test-vol:/p8test-data). The outcome row says 'a named volume', but its reference 59-80 is the code that separates the kinds. No row and no check covers a host-path volume. That case needs both of these: (a) no mkvol exec for it, and (b) the path bind-mounted into the container. Production sets volumes on 5 node statements. The lab can exercise this: e.g. a variant with volumes ['/srv/p8test-bind:/p8test-bind', 'p8test-vol:/p8test-data'], checking that docker volume ls has no '/srv/p8test-bind' entry, that the container's Mounts list a bind with Source /srv/p8test-bind at /p8test-bind, and that the gate run stays event-free (a broken filter would make docker volume create /srv/... fail). restart_service_on_docker_refresh => true (line 90) needs no row: it acts only with docker_service set (run.pp:698-710, default false), so here it does nothing.
